_note: ALL PAPER. Defaults for new installs; edit freely. Percent values are relative to entry (cost basis per token incl. fees). Paper bankroll per book: PAPER_START_CASH env (default 10000) for the human book, auto/policy.json start_cash for the AI book.

rug._note: auto exit, no confirmation, ignores the auto toggle

discovery._doc: discovery.py polls new pools every interval_s (cheap REST, no Grok Bot quota). Candidates that pass deep research are queued in pending_research.json for the CoinGecko-first scanner routine (default every 15 min). If TELEGRAM_FORWARD_URL is set, each candidate is also POSTed to that webhook (faster, but every POST is a Grok Bot routine run = more quota). research_forward=false stops queuing entirely.

take_profit._how: levels recomputed every 60s per token: base ladder multiples scaled by volatility (ATR of 1m candles as % of price), momentum (1m/15s slope), buy/sell flow (5m buy USD share from trade stream), run from launch (price vs first candle), liquidity depth (reserve). Ask on Telegram with Sell X% / Hold / Adjust when price is within approach_pct of a level or hits it.
take_profit._clip_note: clip ladder: take initial out ~2x, then 20% / 15% of ORIGINAL qty at dynamic levels; ~15% runner left to the trailing stop. Prompts Clip/Hold/Skip unless per-position Auto-clip is ON (off by default).

auto_book._doc: AI autonomous book notices (batched <=1 TG msg/min). Set notify false to silence.

scout._doc: SCOUT near-miss tier for human-book alerts (lib/scout.py). Soft-only discards + strong momentum; hard reasons never.

schedule._doc: Cadence of the Grok Bot routines (set in the routine schedule, recorded here for reference). Quota tip: enable ONE scanner by default; each run uses Grok Bot quota.
